trap-meta-commentary.evidence: The '## Honest reporting' section narrates the document's own method instead of doing it: 'Three derivation mechanisms are recorded above. Each has an explicit identified gap. ... Reporting the partial chain is deliberate. Post-hoc numerical identifications are avoided.' Sentences 1-2 describe the block's structure, and 3-4 announce the author's virtue. Announcing that one is reporting honestly is the announced-emphasis pattern; the honesty is already carried by the per-mechanism '**Gap.**' paragraphs and by '## Non-claims', which state scope substantively and pass. Sentence 1 is also miscounted: FOUR mechanisms (A, B, C, D) are recorded above, and the very next sentence refers to 'Mechanism D'.
trap-meta-commentary.notes: Structural - four sentences and the section heading, so not fixed inline. Proposed: delete '## Honest reporting' entirely; the '**Gap.**' paragraphs and '## Non-claims' already carry its content. If a surviving-routes pointer is wanted, keep one sentence and correct the count: 'Of the four mechanisms recorded above, the operator-parity sharpening of C and the virial-scaling D are the two surviving lines of attack.'

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The block ends, after a horizontal rule, with 'What follows carries the distilled conditional theorem, the rigorous results, and the open closure programme; the intermediate candidate mechanisms, and how each was ruled out or sharpened, are not reproduced here.' Nothing follows - it is the last line - so the sentence describes the block that has just ended, in the future tense, and its three-item list restates the block's own section headings. It reads as an editing note that was left in place. '## Honest reporting' compounds this by re-asserting the per-mechanism gaps a second time.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes: Structural - the line is an editorial artefact whose removal is an authorial call, so not fixed inline. Proposed: delete the horizontal rule and the sentence. If the scope note is wanted it belongs at the TOP, as an authorNotes entry (AGENTS.md 4d) rather than as prose, since it is author-tracking about what was pruned rather than content.

trap-superlative.evidence: Three unqualified maximum-strength claims. (i) 'Every mechanism question is resolved.' opens the Status section and is contradicted five sentences later by 'The statement is not closed.' and by the block's own '## Items still missing for closure'. (ii) 'The result is a **clean conditional theorem**.' - 'clean' is self-assessment, not content. (iii) 'No such involution exists.' generalises from the four automorphisms actually checked ($q \mapsto \pm q^{\pm 1}$, See Table 10) to all involutions; the positivity argument two sentences later does support a genuine exclusion, but the headline sentence 'Direct calculation rules out any involution $\iota$ of $R$' claims for a four-case calculation what only the positivity invariant earns.
trap-superlative.notes: Structural. Proposed: (i) 'Each of the four mechanism routes has been carried to an explicit gap or refutation.'; (ii) drop 'clean'; (iii) split the two arguments and label the scope per AGENTS 'Before declaring refuted (STRICT)' - the four-automorphism check is scope-(a) (this construction, alone, does not flip the sign), while the positivity argument is the scope-(b) structural exclusion and should cite positivity by name as the invariant.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Mechanism B's opening sentence nests a colon-parenthetical containing a semicolon, an em-dash and a file link inside one parenthesis, then closes with a second parenthesis holding a cross-reference: 'The molecular SDP is a quadratic program over the Frobenius Gram matrix (**convention D**: read on the quotient $H_n/\mathrm{rad}\,\mathrm{tr}_M \cong \mathrm{TL}_n$, where the induced pairing is non-degenerate; on $H_n$ itself $\det G = 0$ exactly, the $(1^3)$ block being the radical - MarkovGramDegenerate.lean) (prop:operator-selection-lp para dual program).' Two consecutive close-parens carrying different kinds of reference; the sentence cannot be read aloud without losing the thread.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Structural - splitting requires two sentences. Proposed: 'The molecular SDP is a quadratic program over the Frobenius Gram matrix (prop:operator-selection-lp, dual program). Under convention D the pairing must be read on the quotient $H_n/\mathrm{rad}\,\mathrm{tr}_M \cong \mathrm{TL}_n$, where it is non-degenerate; on $H_n$ itself $\det G = 0$ exactly, the $(1^3)$ block being the radical (MarkovGramDegenerate.lean).' NOTE: the convention-D usage here was checked against the corpus and is CORRECT - convention D (z = q^3/(q^2+1)) is exactly what produces the radical and the TL_n quotient (jones-markov-trace.md). No convention-C residue in this block.
